mentions.name: homeassistant.koplugin
mentions.description: A KOReader plugin (for the open-source ebook reader software) that lets users control Home Assistant entities without leaving the book they are currently reading. In development for almost a year, it has evolved from feature-heavy beginnings toward a simpler design focused on clean code and avoiding unnecessary complexity.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a small KOReader (an open-source ebook reader software) plugin that lets you control Home Assistant entities without leaving your current book.
mentions.author: sputge
